text: Live electric cable snapped from transformer pole near Metro Pillar 42, 8th Main Jayanagar. Sparking on the wet road, huge fire danger please send lineman immediately!
Dangerous sparking wire lying on the pavement outside metro pillar 42 in Jayanagar. Pedestrians running away, please cut off power urgently.
Electric wire broke and falling on road near Jayanagar metro pillar 42. School kids walk here, urgent emergency!
Major water pipeline burst opposite Apollo Hospital on Bannerghatta Main Road. Clean drinking water flooding entire road, low water pressure in homes.
Heavy water leakage from municipal main line in front of Apollo clinic Bannerghatta road. Road is completely submerged under 2 feet of water.
Huge crater pothole in the middle of 100ft road near Koramangala 5th Block Junction. Two-wheelers skidding every hour, serious accident risk.
Garbage dump overflowing for last 5 days near Gandhi Bazaar Vegetable Market. Stray cattle and dogs scattering rotting waste, unbearable stench.
Open uncovered manhole on pedestrian sidewalk near City Railway Station Gate 3 in Majestic. Severe danger at night.
Stagnant sewage water breeding dengue and malaria mosquitoes near government primary school in Gandhi Bazaar. Multiple children falling ill, immediate fogging and anti-larval chemical spray required.
Dead stray dog carcass rotting on pedestrian road shoulder opposite market complex in Indiranagar. Unbearable stench, attracting vultures, severe epidemic hazard.
Illegal commercial steel barricades and shop extensions completely blocking pedestrian footpath on 100ft Road Koramangala. School children forced to walk on active vehicle carriageway.
Severe waterlogging and clogged storm drain outside Andheri West Railway Station in Mumbai. Traffic stalled for 3 hours.
Massive garbage pile near Bandra West Linking Road market blocking pedestrian footpath in Mumbai.
Major 4-way traffic signal failure sparking and showing blank at busy junction near Bandra West Linking Road. Massive gridlock and pedestrian near-misses.
Deep hazardous pothole near Connaught Place Outer Circle block B in Delhi causing multiple vehicle punctures.
Open electrical junction box sparking near Hitec City Cyber Towers signal in Hyderabad. High danger for tech park commuters.
Hazardous road crater on ITPL Main Road in Whitefield successfully repaired with asphalt concrete paving.
Sanitation compactor cleared overflowing garbage dumpster and sanitized the entire 100ft road corner in Indiranagar.
Streetlight pole fixed with energy-saving LED luminaire on 4th cross residential layout in Malleshwaram.
